problem: Sessions appear in the session list but open with no conversation history
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. It will print the exact next command.
safety: Quit Claude Desktop fully before any mutation. Diagnose is read-only and safe to run anytime.

problem: Session is in the session list but its conversation history is missing from disk
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. It will check whether a backup copy of the transcript exists.
safety: Needs investigation. The JSONL may exist in a backup, shadow copy, or cloud version history. Diagnose is read-only.

problem: Session is in the session list but its conversation history is missing from disk
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. It will check whether VSS shadow copies contain a recoverable version of the transcript.
safety: Quit Claude Desktop fully before restoring. Diagnose is read-only.

problem: Two sessions in the session list open to the same conversation history
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. It will identify the duplicate metadata files and route you to the cleanup tool.
safety: Quit Claude Desktop fully before any mutation. Diagnose is read-only and safe to run anytime.

problem: Sessions started from a bare drive root rather than a project folder
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. These sessions were likely started from a project root before a worktree was set up; the metadata recorded the bare root path instead of the project path.
safety: These sessions are typically read-only recoverable. Diagnose is read-only and safe to run anytime.

problem: One project shows two sets of sessions in the session list
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. It will identify which metadata files use the junction path and whether repointing is safe.
safety: Quit Claude Desktop fully before any mutation. Do not remove the junction while any session using it is active.

problem: Session opens but its conversation history looks shorter than expected
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. It will count sessions where the JSONL message count is lower than the metadata's completedTurns field.
safety: No mutation available yet. Check cloud sync version history or backup copies for the full JSONL. Diagnose is read-only and safe to run anytime.

problem: Sessions are absent from the session list even though their transcript files exist on disk
what_to_do: Run tools/diagnose.py first. It will count the orphaned transcripts and route you to the synthesis tool.
safety: Quit Claude Desktop fully before any mutation. Diagnose is read-only and safe to run anytime.
